C1.reason: verifier re-execution is not enabled yet; TESTED requires it
C1.text: An independent brute-force computation (DFS component labelling on a padded grid, direct V-E+F count) finds no counterexample to the proposed P1.Bridge identity enc(B) = C8(B) - euler(B) on all 65,536 subsets of a 4x4 box and on 3,000 random rasters up to 12x12 (seed 20261103), and none to the proposed P1.Insertion invariance on 10,496 insertions covering all 256 configurations of the 8-neighbourhood of the inserted pixel, each alone and in 40 random contexts.

C2.label: ASSUMED
C2.text: The proposed statements P1.Insertion and P1.Bridge are true: for every finite raster B in Z^2 under (8,4) connectivity, the set of finite 4-components of Z^2 \ B is finite and its size equals C8(B) - euler(B), and inserting any pixel preserves enclosed - C8 + euler.
